Callout.Name: Horse Loose on the Road
Callout.Message: Horse loose on a county road, drivers swerving.
Callout.Advisory: Animal in the road, owner looking for it.

Script.Line: She got out through the gate somebody left open.
She is a chestnut mare and she is frightened of traffic.
Do not chase her. She will go over the barrier if you chase her.

Lines.Approach: It is in the road and drivers are swerving round it. The owner is out looking.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
